facts.text: Grimny's ghost believed his brother Bral, the greediest of the seven dwarf brothers, killed him, but he did not even know he was dead. Did Bral kill Grimny, and how? The ghost has since departed and can no longer be asked.
What became of Grimny's other brothers, Grelli, Durney, Brenny, Tedry and Rooney, who worked the Dwarven mine with him?
Who burned down the dwarves' log cabin at the foot of the hill by the Dwarven mine, and was it connected to Grimny's death?
